fusions.name: Reading the Cracks
fusions.desc: Jabs the target for a hit that deals 4 damage and leaves it 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds. The hit does 10% more damage for each affliction on the target (max 40%).

fusions.name: Plumb and Level
fusions.desc: Strikes a target up to 7 tiles away and deals 26 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach. It always strikes critically.

fusions.name: Journeyman's Hand
fusions.desc: After a 0.5-second cast, calls an apprentice for 15 seconds. Every 1.5 seconds it strikes an enemy within 5 tiles and deals 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Course by Course
fusions.desc: Every ability you use builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that absorbs 5% of your maximum health per stack (29% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
